scope: Read-only on-demand public YouTube embed and paired displayed clocks; not a scheduled monitor or failover exercise.

qualified_surface.kind: official iframe on a real ephemeral loopback origin
qualified_surface.library: existing paired JST/UTC clock reader; no lowered OCR confidence

preserved_failures: Matching-browser watch page stopped after 39.5 seconds.
AV-only embed intervals passed without proving current content.
HTML seekable and static API duration were rejected as live-edge freshness proofs.
Low-resolution clock readings did not meet the existing confidence threshold.
The first full-artifact mount was unreadable before process entry.
A packaged clock adapter initially lacked its canonical runtime dependency; the cold-load regression now rejects that omission.

migration.reason: Current Prometheus consumers remain on the multi-purpose, FIFO and OCI-egress paths. Consumer migration and rollback proof precede retirement.

limits: The observed surface is the official embedded player; watch-page automation still fails.
A time-of-day display does not independently prove the calendar date.
This is not a long soak, a zero-gap guarantee, human audio validation, provider ingest-selection proof or production failover qualification.
No scheduled player monitoring was enabled.
Raw images, logs, local source snapshots and credentials are excluded from publication.
qualification_source: Native private and portable committed artifacts were independently exercised on the protected receiver.
